meta.title: Cursor/prepare performance benchmarking publishing system 349b
meta.body_summary: Introduce automated benchmarking system with CI workflow, benchmark scripts, and GitHub Pages publishing to track memory/CPU metrics for NNTrainer.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor generated a complex benchmarking system but left numerous scripting bugs; maintainer labeled DO NOT MERGE and PR was closed without fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1159 lines across 10 files, this is a large addition of greenfield infrastructure code by absolute volume. The PR introduced a full benchmarking pipeline but was closed due to persistent functional bugs, which is consistent with the scale and complexity of the change.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot repeatedly detected bugs in run.sh (e.g., command substitution errors, variable mismatches, output path issues) and generate_html.py (os.makedirs failure). Human reviewers questioned the use of debug mode in the benchmark CI and missing end-of-file newlines.
review_details.performance_claim: Automated benchmarking system to track memory consumption and CPU cycles over time.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer added DO NOT MERGE label and did not grant approval; multiple bot bug reports remained unfixed. PR eventually closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor struggled with low-level shell scripting, CI workflow syntax, and Python file handling, introducing numerous bugs that prevented the system from working correctly.

detection_detail.code_reading: skykongkong8 reviewed the workflow and questioned enabling debug mode for benchmarks; DonghakPark flagged missing end-of-file newline.
detection_detail.bot_analysis: cursor[bot] automatically scanned commits and reported multiple critical bugs in run.sh and generate_html.py over several iterations.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The benchmarking scripts contained logical and syntax errors, making the system non-functional and results non-reproducible.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No fixes were applied; maintainer added DO NOT MERGE label after seeing unresolved bot reports, and the PR was eventually closed.

core_change_summary.description: Added a full automated benchmarking system including CI workflow (benchmark_and_publish.yml), benchmark execution script (run.sh), results parser (parse_results.py), HTML report generator (generate_html.py), system test (test_system.sh), and README. Also included unrelated meson/packaging install path changes from a separate commit.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The meson and packaging changes adjust install paths and are unrelated to benchmarking; they appear to be a separate commit bundled in the PR.
change_trajectory: First commit (acb753) made minor build/install path corrections unrelated to benchmarks.
Second commit (734e895) introduced the entire benchmarking system with 1147 lines of new files.
Human reviews identified style (missing EoF) and CI config concerns (debug mode).
Cursor bot continuously reported bugs in run.sh and generate_html.py across multiple force-push iterations.
Maintainer added DO NOT MERGE label; no human approvals were given.
PR was closed without merge after remaining inactive for several days.

review_signals.summary: Questioned whether debug mode should be enabled for benchmarking or was intended for profiling.
review_signals.action_taken: myungjoo replied that Cursor would remove debug mode.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed that Cursor took care of the missing EoF.
Reported multiple bugs: command substitution errors, variable name mismatch in run.sh, output file overwrite, missing tempfile cleanup, and os.makedirs failure in generate_html.py.

collaboration_trajectory: Human reviewers provided minor feedback on style and CI configuration.
Cursor bot automatically detected and reported critical bugs across multiple force-push iterations.
Maintainer added DO NOT MERGE label; no human approvals or fixes followed.
PR closed without merge after extended period of inactivity.
